text: At its meeting of February 5, 2025, City Council adopted Item PH18.3 modifying parking requirements for accessible, bicycle, and visitor parking and expanding the Payment-in-Lieu of Bicycle Parking program. Part 3 of Item PH18.3 rescinded the delegated approval and signing authority from the Chief Planner and Executive Director, City Planning and their designate and delegated the approval and signing authority to the Executive Director, Development Review for agreements related to the Payment-in-Lieu of Bicycle Parking program. Part 4 of Item PH18.3 directed the Executive Director, Development Review to use $538 per "short-term" bicycle parking space reduced, adjusted for inflation, as the basis upon which payments under the Payment-in-Lieu of Bicycle Parking program are to be calculated.
